patch.comment: A list emission that changes nothing no longer touches the DOM. The last item has no successor to be compared against, and was re-appended on every emission — and a node re-inserted where it already stands is still a removal plus an insertion to every mutation observer watching. The renderer now remembers which key ended the previous emission and leaves a last item that stayed last alone; downstream, anything that treats childList mutations as structural change — a portal re-measuring its layout, most of all — stops being told the tree changed when it did not.

Built with TypeScript 7, with each @overload in operators.js moved into its own JSDoc block. Also fixes suspend(): called without a fallback it built an empty options object, and render() invokes options.fallback() unconditionally, so it threw a TypeError. It now defaults to the same '() => NEVER' the Context manager uses, which renders nothing while suspended.
